subject: ZenWave — payment pathway & VAT reconciliation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: ZenWave Finance <finance@zenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 15:30:00 +0000
Subject: Outstanding invoice INV-2027-4490 — proposed payment path

Hi Marta / ZenWave finance team,

Hope you’re well. Following up on invoice INV-2027-4490 for April usage (total EUR 72,450) — due date passed May 1. We haven’t received payment or PO confirmation yet. I know you mentioned VAT/PO coordination on our last call; to keep things moving for both teams I wanted to propose a short recovery path: 

- Customer provides PO number and VAT certificate (or an EU reverse-charge confirmation) by EOB Monday 8 May.
- ZenWave makes a 30% partial payment (EUR 21,735) within 5 business days of PO.
- Remaining balance paid in two equal installments over next 30 days.

If ZenWave needs a slightly different cadence (e.g., net-45 for the remainder) we can discuss, but we’re trying to avoid placing the account on credit hold since the product is in active production.

I’ve attached the invoice and a short payment worksheet. Please let me know the PO # and any tax documents you need from our side. If easier, we can schedule a 20-minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,

— Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-2027-4490.pdf (invoice), payment-plan-template.xlsx (stub)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@zenwave.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Anders Nielsen <anders.n@zenwave.com>
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV-2027-4490 — proposed payment path

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the note. We’re keen to resolve this — two points from our finance team: 

1) ZenWave is subject to Spanish VAT reverse-charge for software services. Our AP team needs the supplier VAT ID and a written statement from Redwood confirming you won’t charge VAT on this invoice (so we can apply reverse-charge).
2) We can issue PO 342 today if Redwood confirms the VAT treatment. We can also do a 30% partial payment after PO is uploaded to our system.

I will attach our standard VAT certificate and loop in our AP lead if needed. Can you confirm the supplier VAT ID and send the written confirmation?

Best,
Marta
Finance Director — ZenWave

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 09:05:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding invoice INV-2027-4490 — ZenWave VAT reverse-charge requirement

Marissa / Michael — forwarding the thread. ZenWave will issue PO 342 if we provide the VAT confirmation. Their timeline is quick (PO today, partial payment after). The risk: if we request formal VAT reversal paperwork from legal, it could add 7–10 business days and push them to hold payments.

As next steps I recommend:
- Marissa: approval to send a short VAT treatment confirmation (one-paragraph from Redwood Finance) while legal finalizes full documentation.
- Michael: if approved, can Finance allow a one-time short credit for ZenWave (i.e., don’t place account in credit hold) conditional on receiving PO + 30% payment within 5 business days?

Context: ZenWave is a current customer using our embeddings + hosted API in production (high QPS). Suspending service would cause immediate disruption for an active feature.

Appreciate quick turn — Marta is expecting our reply today.

— Soojin

Sooj, Michael — thanks for flagging. I’m ok with the proposed operational approach:

- Redwood Finance will send a one-paragraph VAT treatment confirmation with our VAT ID (we’ll mark it as ‘subject to final documentation’).
- Do not place account on credit hold if ZenWave uploads PO 342 and makes 30% partial payment within 5 business days.
- If partial payment is missed, route to collections and consider service interruption after 7 days.

Michael — please confirm you can issue the short VAT confirmation and accept the conditional credit release. If you need legal sign-off on the exact wording, we should use the template below and avoid contract language that could be interpreted as a tax opinion.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Sun, 6 May 2028 14:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoice INV-2027-4490 — payment pathway & VAT reconciliation

Marta / ZenWave, Soojin —

Thanks for the clarity, Marta. Per Marissa’s guidance, Redwood confirms the following for the purposes of ZenWave’s AP process:

"Redwood Inference (VAT ID: GB999999999) confirms that invoice INV-2027-4490 was issued without local Spanish VAT and that ZenWave may apply reverse-charge rules as appropriate under EU VAT law. This confirmation is provided to assist your internal VAT processing and does not constitute a tax opinion. Formal tax documentation will follow from our legal/tax team if required."

We will also attach our supplier VAT certificate to this thread. Once you upload PO 342 and send the 30% partial payment, we will keep services active and defer collections escalation while the remaining plan is executed.

Attachments: VAT_certificate_ES.pdf

— Michael Grant
Finance Director, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
